approval_needed_check.explanation: Because no wallet address was loaded in this phase, no on-chain allowance check was made. Future stage with a wallet address must call ERC20.allowance(owner=wallet, spender=NonfungiblePositionManager) for both USDT and WBNB. If allowance < amount0Desired (USDT) or allowance < amount1Desired (WBNB), an ApproveExact tx is needed for the missing one.
approval_needed_check.policy: ApproveExact ONLY. ApproveMax forbidden. Post-exit revoke required.

mint_or_increaseLiquidity_calldata_draft.method_choice_rationale: This is the very first probe — there is no existing tokenId for the operator's wallet against this pool. mint(params) creates a NEW NFT position and returns its tokenId. increaseLiquidity(params) requires an existing tokenId. Choose mint.
mint_or_increaseLiquidity_calldata_draft.method_signature: mint((address token0, address token1, uint24 fee, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min, address recipient, uint256 deadline))
mint_or_increaseLiquidity_calldata_draft.rationale_for_not_emitting_bytes: Recipient is a placeholder, so ABI-encoding the full calldata now would yield bytes that could NEVER be sent (recipient slot would be all zeros — would revert or send to zero address). The next stage with a real wallet address must encode bytes after re-quoting.

post_exit_revoke_calldata_draft_per_toke.purpose: Revoke USDT allowance to PositionManager after exit. Mandatory per risk-limits policy.
Revoke WBNB allowance to PositionManager after exit. Mandatory per risk-limits policy.

step1_decreaseLiquidity.method: decreaseLiquidity((uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min, uint256 deadline))

step2_collect.method: collect((uint256 tokenId, address recipient, uint128 amount0Max, uint128 amount1Max))

step3_burn_optional.note: Optional. Burn the NFT after liquidity drained and fees collected to clean up wallet. Refunds a small amount of gas.

swap_back_calldata_draft_if_needed.applies_when: Operator wants to consolidate residual balances back to a single token after exit (e.g. all-USDT or all-WBNB).
swap_back_calldata_draft_if_needed.default_recommendation_for_probe: DO NOT swap back. The 10/20U probe goal is to MEASURE the round-trip economics; an explicit swap-back adds another quote drift risk (S4 in risk_limits) and isn't needed for tokenId/fee data.

if_human_overrides.method: exactInputSingle((address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, address recipient, uint256 deadline, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMinimum, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96))

next_stage_must_do_before_any_real_tx: verify wallet address is in operator's local allowlist
re-quote via QuoterV2 within 60s of mint tx submission
recompute amount0Min / amount1Min from fresh quote
encode full ABI bytes only AFTER recipient is filled and deadline is set
simulate full tx via eth_call with from=wallet BEFORE signing
human types explicit phrase to authorize signing
still NOT this round's responsibility — that's a future stage's gate
